== Acquisition ==
Automatically equipped upon entry into the [[Rollerbeetle Racing (outpost)|Rollerbeetle Racing outpost]].

==Notes==
*The skill descriptions omit that this skill can only be recharged by passing through a [[Rollerbeetle Racing#Checkpoints|checkpoint]].

{{bug|If you encounter any change of speed after activating Rollerbeetle Dash — even by [[Ram]] or [[Water]] ending — you risk gaining no benefit for the remainder of the [[duration]].}}
